description.en: Sets a scale multiplier applied to a character's silhouette outline width (see CMND_SET_CHARA_SIL_WIDTH). Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.

example.code:
// Double the width of a character's silhouette outline
CMND_SET_CHARA_SIL_SCALEW(hChara, 2.0);
